cohort_binding_correction.effect: No cohort row, order, token-label identity, family allocation, or scientific condition changed.

decision_mapping.CONTROLLABLE_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT: At least one identity-valid implicit Batch1-versus-batched comparison fails; every matched explicit Batch1-versus-batched comparison passes; every Batch1 explicit-versus-implicit semantic-preservation comparison passes; and every required repeat-stability check passes. This permits only a position-ID repair proposal and fresh review.
decision_mapping.INCONCLUSIVE: Any missing, partial, nonfinite, identity-invalid, runtime-cap-exceeded, or contract-deviating evidence. No automatic follow-on is authorized.
decision_mapping.MEASUREMENT_VALID: Every required identity, finiteness, and repeat-stability check passes and every checkpoint-family REFERENCE_B1_IMPLICIT_POSITION versus BATCHED_IMPLICIT_POSITION comparison is <= 0.0005. The explicit pair remains recorded as the preregistered causal control.
decision_mapping.NO_STABLE_MODE: Complete, identity-valid, finite execution that satisfies neither previous rule.

execution_order.fallback_policy: Only the requested batched mode uses the frozen ladder. Batch1 never falls back. OOM or runtime failure before a common batched size binds is INCONCLUSIVE.
execution_order.model_reload_policy: load once per checkpoint; do not reload between its three modes; release model and clear CUDA allocator only between checkpoints
execution_order.row_order: exact listed cohort order; no length sorting or reshuffling

fixed_forward_contract.aggregation_dtype: float32 logits followed by float32 per-token cross entropy; token-micro mean over nonignored shifted labels.
fixed_forward_contract.attention_mask: 1 for original tokens and 0 for trailing pad tokens; passed to every forward.
fixed_forward_contract.causal_label_shift: logits[:, :-1, :] versus labels[:, 1:]; labels equal -100 are ignored.

forbidden: no DEV or retention labels in NLL

modes.position_ids: attention_mask.long().cumsum(-1)-1, then positions at mask==0 set to 0; passed explicitly to model
modes.single_preregistered_distinction: position-ID construction only; all inputs, right padding, attention mask, dtype, logits cast, causal shift, aggregation, model instance, and order are unchanged.

modes.effective_batch_selection: Use first successful value from frozen ladder [32,16,8,4,1] during V7 mode initialization; bind that value for all remaining checkpoints and both batched modes. Any later inability to use the bound size is INCONCLUSIVE.

modes.position_ids: attention_mask.long().cumsum(-1)-1, then positions at mask==0 set to 0; passed explicitly to model
modes.requested_batch_size: same bound effective batch as BATCHED_IMPLICIT_POSITION
modes.single_preregistered_distinction: position-ID construction only; all inputs, padding, attention mask, dtype, logits cast, causal shift, aggregation, model instance, and order are unchanged.

numeric_acceptance.comparison_unit: per checkpoint and per weak family token-micro NLL; all required units must pass.
numeric_acceptance.rationale: This is 5 percent of the independently frozen 0.01 nats/token fit-effect threshold: a valid measurement mode must make numerical variation at least twenty-fold smaller than a future material-fit contrast. It is prospectively stricter than, and does not modify, the closed branch 0.001 rule.
required_comparisons_per_checkpoint_and_: max pairwise drift among 3 REFERENCE_B1_IMPLICIT_POSITION repeats
max pairwise drift among 3 REFERENCE_B1_EXPLICIT_POSITION_CONTROL repeats
max pairwise drift among 3 BATCHED_IMPLICIT_POSITION repeats
max pairwise drift among 3 BATCHED_EXPLICIT_POSITION_CONTROL repeats
absolute mean difference: REFERENCE_B1_IMPLICIT_POSITION versus BATCHED_IMPLICIT_POSITION
absolute mean difference: REFERENCE_B1_EXPLICIT_POSITION_CONTROL versus BATCHED_EXPLICIT_POSITION_CONTROL
absolute mean difference: REFERENCE_B1_EXPLICIT_POSITION_CONTROL versus REFERENCE_B1_IMPLICIT_POSITION

purpose: Validate one fixed teacher-forced NLL measurement procedure only; it cannot classify fitting, generalization, or gradient mechanisms.
